Title: ambrosius with bestowed vigor plays skin of night

Messages.Author: Malone
Messages.Body:
Benedict Giovanni puts Bestow Vigor (I think that's what that new card
is called) on Ambrosius the Ferryman, who then gets into combat and
plays Skin of Night. Brosie is now immune to non-ag damage and treats
ag damage as normal damage. Does that mean he is effectively immune
to all damage (except by specific card text, like on Cleave)?
